binder_assessment.complete_review_coverage: Requires exact targetset equality and unique proof rows for every case and proposal, plus complete matching author routing.
binder_assessment.staleness: Checks full canonical decision/proposal digests, frozen caseinputsha, and exact aftercapture; main captures/rehashes every full candidate bytefile with FrozenFile.
binder_assessment.independence: Only /root/final_reviewer is admitted; normalized currentrouting and originalauthors are checked and authorship_conflict must be literalFalse. This is content/attribution validation, not cryptographic reviewer authentication; actual reviewartifact and workflow attribution still require final independent assembly inspection.
binder_assessment.review_state: Only approve or findings_open rows with nonempty reasoning/reviewmode accepted. The bound independent_review.status=complete means work completed; per-target findings_open status remains in proof and bindingreceipt. No accepted/closed scientific status is fabricated.
binder_assessment.mutation_scope: Affected105 cases have only independent_review metadata changed; code removes that field before equality assertion. Proposal ledger is emitted from original held bytes, all117 payloads are read-only. One independent-review evidence link and bindingreceipt are added.
binder_assessment.execution_status: Actual Dproof binding was not executed by this reviewer; Dproof forthcoming at assignment. Final bound output must still be checked against exact supplied proof and source selection before publication.

capture_helper_assessment.interpretation: The helper constructs source/candidate target metadata and invokes existing record_review.py inspect; it does not generate scientific findings or approve owners. Labels/selectors are tied to the unchanged188cases; candidatepaths are exactly117selectedpayloads. Source-only cases use ownership_note; existingownerpaths remain baseline comparisons.
capture_helper_assessment.freshness_limit: New files created after this frozen capture are not retroactively included. This review verifies the declared3317capturedinputs; final assembly may bind later technicalmetadata separately.

publication_limits: Outputpath guard refuses traversal, noncanonical resolved paths and aliasing; existing outputdirectories refused. FrozenFile holds exactsourceinputs and main rechecks them before/after nativepublication.

Shared native publish_new_files is bounded exclusive publication, not an atomic multi-file transaction or universal hostile-concurrency/late-hardlink guarantee. Failed invocations, residual directories or diagnostic artifacts must remain failed until a new exact success receipt is independently verified.

Hardcoded revieweridentity and proof fields cannot by themselves prove actual agency/authorship or adequacy of skeptical science review. This code validates exact declared rows; D actual review receipt and final assembly audit remain required.
